scope: Source and local synthetic-process / real-filesystem fixture review. No production batch, throughput or current host qualification.
verified: Protected input requires the actual original metadata operation, actual selected receipt and distinct selection-completion acknowledgement. The old failed selection is never relabelled successful.

Genuine completion own-intent/start-actor validation binds the acknowledged current worker; its optional intermediate actor record is distinguished from required original native-started and selected records.
The original provenance body is reused unchanged: finite indices 0 through 127, at most 5000 rows per batch, original canonical and full publication proof, and no deletion of unmatched rows.
The explicit first-index-zero, one-batch, 900-second fixture dispatches exactly one original provenance operation. New dispatch requires 720 seconds remaining after current prechecks.
Original intent/result/observed ancestry is contiguous. Any existing prefix, unknown outcome, busy result or zero progress prevents another dispatch for that index.
Initial and final full source qualification plus fresh source/READ, selected actor, boot and exact index checks preserve the admitted phase. No stale whole-role-graph claim is substituted.
Exclusive private journals precede dispatch; changed actor/source/selection or failed postflight retains original evidence and refuses a successful runner result.
No service-manager, DDL, new grant, budget or routing entrypoint is introduced. Genuine official provenance effects remain visible as effects, not described as read-only.
